newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up six cents, tracks London's rise.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up six cents, tracks London's rise.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up six cents at 14.68 ringgit ($5.90) a kg, helped by a rebound on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.
"Buying was encouraged by higher LME last night," a trader said, noting initial bids for 140 tonnes against offers for 94.
Final turnover was 110 tonnes, up from 83 on Thursday, and buyers were gain from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
Traders said they expected the price to remain in the 14.50-15.00 range in the near term. The local price premium over the LME narrowed to $20 a tonne against $30 previously.
